title: Remove nonprod-deploy drift-recovery chain and require dev-login proof on artifact restore
summary: Removed the nonprod-deploy drift-recovery chain (_drift_recovery_source, allowed_revisions, DRIFT_FIELDS, drift_args, PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE, PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA), returning rollback authority strictly to previous_backend_sha. Partially reverted #5908 by requiring viewer dev-login proof on artifact restore while capture, seal-candidate, and verify retain declared literal-false absence recording.

head_run.pre_existing_failures_explained: All 3 remaining failures are pre-existing at merge base in this worker environment and are not regressions caused by this task. The 4th pre-existing failure (test_actual_ssh_command_forwards_drift_metadata) was intentionally removed as part of removing the drift-forwarding chain.

acceptance_checklist.criterion: 1. Zero matches for drift tokens and allowed_revisions in production scripts
acceptance_checklist.details: git grep -n -E 'PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_(BASELINE_SOURCE|OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA)|baseline_source|baseline-source|observed_live_bff_sha|observed-live-bff-sha|_drift_recovery_source|DRIFT_FIELDS|drift_args|drift_sha|live_bff_drift_recovery' -- scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py scripts/dev_release_artifacts.py scripts/capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh returns no match, and git grep -n allowed_revisions -- scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py scripts/dev_release_artifacts.py returns no match.

acceptance_checklist.criterion: 2. Zero matches for drift tokens in test files
acceptance_checklist.details: git grep -n -E 'drift_args|BASELINE_SOURCE|OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA|baseline_source|observed_live_bff_sha|--baseline-source|--observed-live-bff-sha|allowed_revisions|_extract_artifact_driver_invocation' -- scripts/test_dev_release_artifact_driver.py scripts/test_dev_release_artifacts.py scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_env_parity.py returns no match.

acceptance_checklist.details: git diff against merge base only deletes the two GITHUB_OUTPUT lines and four env lines; rollback_baseline classification and rollback-baseline.json write remain byte-identical.
